title: Design System: Agentic Harness public pages (the project explainer)

scope.planPageSystem: design/DESIGN.md and design/.impeccable/design.json. Not replaced by this file. The two share the colour tokens and the type roles.
decided: The owner, 2026-10-12: public pages are the same family as the plan pages, expanded.
The owner, 2026-10-12: the structure of the explainer is the figure atlas.
The owner, 2026-10-12: this surface has no margin rule.
scope.approval: Every entry with status 'approved by the owner, 2026-10-13' is new on this surface and is recorded from the built page.

display.purpose: The page title only. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

headline.purpose: Each figure heading and each text-section heading. Size approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

title.purpose: The product name in the top bar.

fact-lead.purpose: The first value of a facts form. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

band.purpose: Uppercase sub-headings inside plates and text sections, in form.

label.purpose: Form labels, table heads, figure numbers in the list of figures, button text.

lane.purpose: Owner lane names, in owner ink.

lead.purpose: The one line under the title, in ink-2. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

body.purpose: Prose and lists, 44rem measure, tabular figures.

caption.purpose: The text of the caption column.

note.purpose: Sources and limits under a figure, in ink-2.

rings.name: selected-ring
rings.purpose: Selected node, pipeline step, session item, run step. No offset, no blur. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

rings.name: selected-ring-thin
rings.purpose: Selected action chip and session moment. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve (--ease). Shared with the plan pages.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and selected state of parts and buttons.

motion.name: travel
motion.value: 9px square along a line; progress 1 - 2^(-9t); 380 to 640ms a hop (default 640ms)
motion.purpose: The travelling mark. One per plate. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

motion.name: travel-reduced
motion.value: no mark; the line thickens to 2.4px; 260ms wait; longer pause at each stop
motion.purpose: The same steps under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

motion.name: land
motion.value: translateY(-10px) and opacity 0 to rest; .6s var(--ease)
motion.purpose: The flag mark lands on a step of the strength scale. Only under no-preference.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: A heading reached from the list of figures. Only under no-preference. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.value: scroll-behavior: smooth; auto under reduced motion
motion.purpose: Jumps from the list of figures.

breakpoints.name: caption-stack
breakpoints.purpose: The caption column stacks: heading, plate, body.

breakpoints.name: rail-strip
breakpoints.purpose: The list of figures becomes a sticky strip that scrolls sideways.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Plates become one or two columns; tables stack; touch targets are 2.75rem.

breakpoints.name: labels-off
breakpoints.purpose: Line labels and some lines are not drawn.

keyboard.value: Roving tab stop inside each figure: Tab enters once; arrow keys, Home, End move; the selected part holds the tab stop.

narrative.northStar: The Witnessed Notebook, as a figure atlas
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Witnessed Notebook, as a figure atlas"**

The page is a book of plates. Nine numbered figures carry the explanation, and the text beside each figure is its caption. The reader selects a part of a figure, and a small form next to it states the facts for that part.

The paper is flat and cool. Rules and labels are printed in green-grey. Colour names who acts: green for the user, clay for Claude, cobalt for any other agent. Graphite pencil marks what is unknown, manual, or not built. Corners are square. There are no drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: A list of figures at the left is the contents.
Each figure is a plate with a caption column.
The figure number is part of the heading.
Diagram lines are drawn from where the parts really are.
One small square travels a line to show one rule in motion.
Selected parts take a 7 percent form tint and an inset ring.
Unknowns and manual steps are dashed.

rules.name: The Owner Ink Rule
rules.body: An owner ink marks who acts: node borders and lane labels. A node with no owner takes form green-grey. There are three owner inks and no fourth.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: What is unknown, not observed, or not built is written in pencil, in italics, with a dashed line or border.

rules.name: The No Margin Rule
rules.body: This surface has no margin rule. Margin pink-red is not a token here. (The owner, 2026-10-12.)

rules.name: The Folded Number Rule
rules.body: A figure heading reads "Fig. N." and then its title, in one heading. The number is in form green-grey. No label sits above a heading. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

rules.name: The Form Label Rule
rules.body: A label names a form field or is the heading of its block. It is never stacked above a heading that already names the block.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures stay tabular (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on body).

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows. A tint is a state, not a panel: form tint marks hover, selected, and the current table row. The only resting tint is the inline code chip.

rules.name: The Inset Ring Rule
rules.body: A selected part takes the form tint and an inset ring in its own border colour (1px or 1.5px, `box-shadow: inset`). The ring has no offset and no blur. Approved by the owner, 2026-10-13.

dos: **Do** open every plate with a 2px form top rule and a 1px rule border.
**Do** fold the figure number into the heading: "Fig. N." in form, then the title.
**Do** colour a node border by its owner; use form when there is no owner.
**Do** draw every diagram line from the measured position of its two parts.
**Do** dash what is manual, and write what is unknown or not built in pencil.
**Do** show selection with the form tint and an inset ring, and say it in `aria-pressed`.
**Do** keep each plate to one travelling mark, and stop the travel under reduced motion.
**Do** put a facts form next to each interactive figure.
**Do** keep text at AA contrast on paper in both themes.
donts: **Don't** add a margin rule or margin pink-red to this surface.
**Don't** add drop shadows, gradients, or rounded panels.
**Don't** fill a resting panel with a tint; a tint means hover, selected, or current.
**Don't** stack a label above a heading as a kicker.
**Don't** add a fourth owner ink; any owner that is not Claude or the user is agent.
**Don't** make content reachable by motion or hover alone.
